attributes.illustration_led: Artwork is the dominant presentation feature.
attributes.full_art: Artwork extends beyond the standard illustration box.
attributes.extended_art: Artwork/frame is extended beyond the standard frame; requires explicit metadata.
attributes.alternate_artwork: Alternate artwork for an otherwise corresponding card.
attributes.textured: Physical/textured print treatment is explicitly established.
attributes.gold_or_gilded: Gold-colored border, frame, or accents are intrinsic to the treatment.
attributes.shiny: The depicted Pokémon is explicitly a Shiny treatment.
attributes.reverse_holo: Foil outside the ordinary illustration treatment.
attributes.gallery_style: Named gallery/subset illustration presentation; requires explicit metadata.
attributes.trainer_gallery_style: Named Trainer Gallery presentation; requires explicit metadata.
attributes.vintage_specialty: Era-local historical specialty with no asserted modern equivalence.
attributes.promo_only: Distribution-specific promo status; never inferred from rarity alone.
attributes.unique_mechanic_treatment: Presentation is bundled with a named gameplay/form mechanic.

definitions.era_local_label: Publisher/API rarity designation interpreted only inside its era.
definitions.semantic_attributes: Observable presentation properties; never an ordinal global ladder.

detection.unassignedAttributes: require future explicit metadata or versioned manual override
